conclusion: The current Triton boundary is metadata-only: the runtime can inspect pinned gfx950 HSACO images, but the normal Triton extension and HIP launch path are not yet available in this checkout.
decision: Keep Triton end-to-end at 0/1. First build the pinned Triton/LLVM pair or record a reproducible compile-only substitute, then implement PT_LOAD mapping, AQL/kernarg, and a simulator launcher before changing the user-facing claim.
invalidated_assumptions: A parsed HSACO metadata record is equivalent to a launched Triton kernel.
An extension built from a different Triton/LLVM checkout can be reused as proof for the pinned checkout.
observation: Two pinned gfx950 probes report metadata_only=true and execution_supported=false; the pinned Triton extension attempt stops at TritonGPUMemoryEffects.td because the available LLVM TableGen API is not the locked LLVM revision, and no HIP runtime/device is present.
question_or_symptom: Why has no unmodified Triton vecadd case passed yet, and what is the next reproducible prerequisite?
